Essay series

Thoughtful interfaces

Software was a destination for twenty years. Now the work arrives where you already are, inside the agent. That one shift rewires enterprise buying, deployment, architecture, product execution, UX, and roles. Nine essays, one argument.

Nine essays, published July 14 through August 11, 2026.
